note: Alberta Parks recreation area in mixed boreal forest 37.5 km S of Valleyview on Hwy 43; RV/tent sites plus a reservable group-use area, picnic shelter, firepits. Trails lead to the Little Smoky and Iosegun rivers for paddling and fishing. No firewood for sale. --Claude
